scope: Static and local socket-pair/native-subprocess verification only; no real desktop input, microphone, clipboard or user-window activation

native_dependency.data: fixed pc/us map from installed xkeyboard-config; validated V=47+8 and Control index2

protocol_checks: SCM_RIGHTS memfd readback and fixed keymap
last focus check after protocol setup, before any input
possible input plus disconnect/missing final ACK produces Unknown without repeat press
partial frame cleanup closes rather than appending protocol frames
no-input cleanup never sends modifier/key input
deadline_checks: keymap preparation is background-only cached startup work; unavailable preparation returns Manual without waiting
input protocol and last focus queries share one 500ms deadline
nonblocking bounded helper output uses original deadline and no reader/writer joins
a real direct child exits while its descendant holds stdout; deadline kills the retained process group
diagnostics 128KiB and clipboard 4MiB output limits remain distinct
desktop_acceptance: pending parent controlled own-window trusted-event/readback test
production_adapter: internal Wayland virtual-keyboard Ctrl+V; wtype remains M0 diagnostic only
